description:
Lucasfilm expands the Star Wars universe with The Mandalorian And Grogu (2026), bringing the legendary bounty hunter Din Djarin and the fan-favorite Grogu to the big screen in an all-new cinematic adventure. Set after the events of The Mandalorian, the film follows Din Djarin as he navigates a changing galaxy alongside Grogu, facing new threats and powerful enemies tied to the remnants of the Empire.

The film stars Pedro Pascal as Din Djarin and features Sigourney Weaver in a major new role within the Star Wars universe. Directed by Jon Favreau, the project blends cinematic storytelling with the grounded, character-driven tone that made the original series a global phenomenon.

With high-stakes action, deep lore connections, and a continuation of Grogu’s journey, The Mandalorian And Grogu marks a major evolution of the Star Wars saga on the big screen.

Release Date: 2026
Studio: Lucasfilm
Director: Jon Favreau
Cast: Pedro Pascal, Sigourney Weaver
